invariants: Every terminal state requires evidence_recovery_status=EXHAUSTED unless the boundary is CONCLUSIVE.
external_effect_knowledge is always UNKNOWN in this contract.
validated_completion_eligible is always false in reconciliation state.
CLOSED_NO_LIVE_DISPATCH means no live process was observed, not that external effect is known absent.
Historical attempt records remain immutable; reconciliation is an append-only overlay.
negative_gates: Known external effect cannot replace UNKNOWN.
Terminal state cannot be marked validated-completion eligible.
claim_ceiling: Repository-local reconciliation state machine only; no external success, failure, no-effect, production readiness, Owner acceptance or epistemic upgrade is inferred.
